result.brief: 将预训练视频生成器改造为统一的第一人称动作-视频模型，用角色自适应动作渲染器提供视频原生动作表征，实现动作条件生成、姿态估计与联合动作-视频生成。
result.reason: Adapts pretrained video generators into a unified action-conditioned egocentric video model with video-native action representations and cross-stream coupling, spanning generation and pose estimation.
